title: Fetch a URL and convert its HTML content to Markdown. Handles redirects, downloa
description: Fetch a URL and convert its HTML content to Markdown. Handles redirects, downloads the HTML, and returns clean Markdown suitable for LLM context windows or document processing. Use this to read and summarize web pages, documentation, or articles. Send {"url": "https://..."}. Remote fetch timeout: 5s, max download size: 2 MB.

_signals.x_guidance:
UtilsForAgents provides eight paid utility endpoints for AI agents plus one free feedback endpoint. Paid utility calls cost $0.003 USD each and use the x402 v2 payment protocol — no API keys or accounts needed. POST /v1/feedback is free, unauthenticated, and excluded from x402 discovery.

Payment flow for paid utility routes:
1. POST JSON (or binary for image endpoints) to a paid /v1/* utility path.
2. The server replies HTTP 402 with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (base64-encoded JSON containing an `accepts` array of payment requirements).
3. Choose one returned payment requirement and sign the matching USDC payment for that network. Current production options are Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`) and Solana mainnet (`solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp`).
4. Retry the identical request with a `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header (base64-encoded payment payload).
5. On valid payment the server returns the normal 200 result with a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header containing settlement details.

Endpoints at a glance:
• POST /v1/diff — structural JSON diff (RFC 6902 ops, RFC 6901 pointers). Send {"left": ..., "right": ...}.
• POST /v1/image/exif-summary — EXIF extraction from JPEG. Send raw image/jpeg binary body.
• POST /v1/image/scrub-metadata — strip EXIF/XMP/IPTC from JPEG or PNG. Send raw binary body, returns cleaned image.
• POST /v1/html/to-markdown — convert an HTML string to Markdown. Send {"html": "..."}.
• POST /v1/html/fetch-markdown — fetch a URL, convert its HTML to Markdown. Send {"url": "..."}.
• POST /v1/text/fetch-content — fetch a URL, auto-detect format, return Markdown/text. Send {"url": "..."}.
• POST /v1/url/metadata — fetch a URL, extract Open Graph / Twitter Card / meta tags. Send {"url": "..."}.
• POST /v1/utilities/count-tokens — count tokens for LLM input. Send {"text": "..."}.
• POST /v1/feedback — submit product or feature feedback for agents. Send {"text": "..."}. Free, max 600 chars.

GET /health and POST /v1/feedback are free and unauthenticated.

All JSON endpoints accept Content-Type: application/json. Image endpoints accept image/jpeg or image/png. Max upload: 5 MB. Remote-fetch endpoints limit downloaded content to 2 MB and time out after 5 s.
